## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Pre-commit, Ruff, strict mypy, and the required pytest coverage gate pass.
- [ ] Packaging and dependency checks pass when affected.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when appropriate.

## Safety and data review

- [ ] The change contains no credentials, real recordings or transcripts, personal
      data, private paths, customer or employer information, or unreviewed provider
      output.
- [ ] Cloud transmission, cost, consent, privacy, security, and platform effects
      are documented where applicable.
- [ ] New examples and fixtures are synthetic.
